item.title: 🤝 Merger · Definitive · BSVN
item.scanner:headline: Acquires ~71% of Century Financial for $88.96M cash
item.description:
Acquires ~71% of Century Financial for $88.96M cash

Won a court-supervised auction to acquire approximately 71% of Century Financial Services Corporation, increasing the purchase price from $68.0 million to $88.96 million (after a $2.04 million break-up fee credit on a $91.0 million bid). The shares are being purchased from the receiver of the KS StateBank receivership estate. The transaction remains subject to court approval (Sale Order) and Federal Reserve approval.

About: Bank7 Corp. operates as a bank holding company for Bank7 that provides banking and financial services to individual and corporate customers. It provides commercial deposit, commercial checking, money market, and other deposit accounts; and retail deposit services, such as certificates of deposit, money market accounts, checking accounts, negotiable order of withdrawal accounts, savings accounts, and automated teller machine access.

  • Counterparty: Century Financial Services Corporation
  • Deal value: $88,960,000
  • Stake: ~71%
  • Consideration: cash
  • Announced: 2026-09-03
  • Next catalyst: Court Sale Order and Federal Reserve approval

item.title: 🔎 Strategic Review · Portfolio Review · CVV
item.scanner:headline: Restructures: exits new equipment orders, halves workforce, CEO departs; explores asset sales
item.description:
Restructures: exits new equipment orders, halves workforce, CEO departs; explores asset sales

Announced a restructuring plan to stop pursuing new system orders for its CVD equipment business, reducing workforce by approximately half and recording a $0.8-1.0M restructuring charge in Q3 2026. CEO Emmanuel Lakios departed, replaced by Warren Cheesman as Acting CEO. The board continues to evaluate cost reductions, asset monetization, and real estate alternatives to enhance shareholder value.

About: CVD Equipment Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of equipment to develop and manufacture materials and coatings in the United States, North America, Europe, the Middle East, Europe, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. The company operates through three segments: CVD Equipment, Stainless Design Concepts, and MesoScribe.
